# AnimeCharactersList.com

AnimeCharactersList.com is a comprehensive, static, search-engine-optimized fan directory cataloging 100+ anime characters and 10 major franchises. It features interactive personality quizzes, head-to-head combat parameters comparisons, custom lists, and a rich editorial blog.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Astro (static site generation)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS (v4.0.0 via Vite plugin)
- **Interactivity**: Alpine.js (zero-backend dynamic pages)
- **Data Source**: JSON database files in `src/data/`
- **Monetization**: Google AdSense slots integrated dynamically
- **SEO Elements**: Automatic JSON-LD Schema (WebSite, Person, Article, ItemList)

## File Structure & Routing
- `/` - Landing page with hero section, recent articles, features list, and auto-completing live search.
- `/characters/` - Main catalog with search inputs, series/role filters, sorting parameters, and hybrid DOM pagination.
- `/character/[slug]` - Deep profiles featuring ratings, stats table, abilities power bars, transformation milestones, relationships, and accordion FAQs.
- `/anime/` - List of all indexed franchises including episode counts and studios.
- `/anime/[slug]` - Franchise profile listing synopsis, metrics, and associated cast grids.
- `/list/` - Rankings directory covering strongest characters, villains, and duos.
- `/list/[slug]` - Top rankings list detail pages containing numbered position cards.
- `/blog/` - Articles directory covering guides, history, and analyses.
- `/blog/[slug]` - Articles detail pages with in-built markdown compiler.
- `/quiz/` - Interactive quizzes index.
- `/quiz/[slug]` - AlpineJS personality character matchers and trivia games.
- `/comparison/` - Head-to-head stats compare arena with visual progress bars.
- `/comparison/[slug]` - Predefined legendary matchup analyses (e.g. Goku vs Naruto).
- `/admin` - Private client-side JSON record editor (password-protected: `admin123`).

## Sitemap index
Sitemap indexing details are available at: https://animecharacterslist.com/sitemap-index.xml
All admin-related panel paths are strictly excluded.
